concept_attempts.feedback: Selected after comparison with own paletted body1 and all41 catalogue updates. Preserves squat truncated-square grey-blue concrete base, open chamfered-square well with pale lip/red outer band, broad front service recess, exactly three brass bent side fittings, two close tall brass supports with narrow two-rail crosshead, and one short pale roof upright. Wear is appropriate and quiet surfaces remain readable. Precise beam inclination/rib count, hidden structure, lining/floor depth, dimensions and red-band profile are interpreted. No generic Terran iris, firing cycle or missile loader inferred.

glb_feedback.finding: Actual source/concept/independent GLB whole/front/rear/well comparison inspected. Counts, supports and true open well pass, but the visible mouth is too narrow relative to its pale lip and brass reads dark brown rather than source/concept ochre. Widen aperture halfwidth .32 to .36 with matching body opening/lining/floor and support guards, brighten brass map and soften bent fitting edges. Preserve all source counts and static open anatomy.
limitations: Metric dimensions/hidden floor remain authored; source-like camera is not calibrated recovery.

glb_feedback.finding: Inspected final actual own-source/selected-concept/independent GLB whole/front/rear/well comparison board, final native hero and bent-fitting/front-recess detail. Widening the well from .64 to .72 clear width, brightening tarnished brass and rounding the three fitting edges improve the source/concept match. Source counts and quiet cast silhouette remain intact. Actual saved-native/independent GLB checks pass:1732triangles/9positiveclosedmeshes/5materials/7maps, thirty support witnesses, three bent brass fittings and two tall supports, two rails/six authored ribs and one short post, one blind service recess/backing, nine deep-well rays to floorZ.10, inner walls at three heights, cast slope, two real wear chips, root and decoded texture pixels. Maximum surface error5.960464477539063e-8. No significant further source/concept discrepancy requiring another model pass identified.
limitations: Exact hidden rear, wall/lining/floor depths, support engineering, rib count and cell-relative dimensions are authored. Camera approximates the source, not calibrated recovery.
Static open own source does not establish a closing lid, iris, heading action, firing cycle or generic Terran loader. No operating clip is supplied.
